cookies.metaDescription: How CyberSkill uses cookies and similar technologies on our World of Tanks boosting website, and how you can manage your cookie preferences.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy

what.heading: 1. What Are Cookies?
what.body: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to website owners.

howWeUse.heading: 2. How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.intro: CyberSkill uses cookies for the following purposes:
howWeUse.essentialDesc: Required for the website to function properly
howWeUse.performanceDesc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website
howWeUse.analyticsDesc: Collect anonymous data about website usage

session.title: Session Cookies
session.description: Temporary cookies that expire when you close your browser. These are essential for navigating the website and using its features.

persistent.title: Persistent Cookies
persistent.description: Remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them. These help us remember your preferences across visits.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.description: Set by third-party services we use, such as analytics providers. These help us improve our services and understand user behavior.

managing.heading: 5. Managing Cookies
managing.intro: You can control and manage cookies in several ways:
managing.item1: Use your browser settings to block or delete cookies
managing.item2: Adjust your cookie preferences in our cookie consent banner
managing.item3: Use browser extensions or privacy tools
managing.item4: Clear cookies regularly through your browser
managing.note: Please note that blocking essential cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

thirdParty.heading: 6. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: We use third-party services that may set cookies, including:
thirdParty.note: These third parties have their own privacy policies and cookie policies.

updates.heading: 7. Updates to This Policy
updates.body: We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. Please check this page periodically for updates.

contact.heading: 8. Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at privacy@cyberskill.com.
